title: The Kerala Finance Bill, 2025

summary.what_is_bill: 'The Kerala Finance Bill, 2025' (Bill No. 250 of 2025) is a State legislative measure introduced in the Kerala Legislative Assembly (Vidhan Sabha) concerning State Finance / Taxation.
summary.what_it_changes: The bill introduces statutory amendments to existing state legislation, primarily modifying Amendment of the Kerala Stamp Act, 1959; In the Kerala Stamp Act, 1959; Amendment of the Kerala General Sales Tax Act, 1963 across 3 identified sections/clauses.
summary.why_it_matters: According to the official Statement of Objects and Reasons: "The annual financial statement presented before the Legislative Assembly outlines revenue mobilization measures, rationalization of stamp duties, tax compliance enhancements, and resource generation for infrastructure development across Kerala."
summary.who_is_affected: Primary affected groups include: Taxpayers, Commercial Enterprises, Traders & Merchants, State Revenue Department.
key_provisions: Statutory modification of Amendment of the Kerala Stamp Act, 1959, In the Kerala Stamp Act, 1959.
Identified clauses/sections amended: Section 1, Section 2, Section 3.
Contains statutory fee, tax, or duty rate provisions.
summary.administrative_implications: Enforced through the competent administrative departments of the Government of Kerala.
summary.legislative_status: Official status recorded as 'Passed Both' (introduced on 2025-02-10).
